decision: Retain the existing 250k rich-combat specialist. Combined enemy/player HP potential is a tentative lead versus the matched fresh-critic control, but its greedy gain is driven by one seed and no new endpoint beats the parent. Enemy-only shaping is inconsistent. Keep PBRS opt-in.
next_useful_step: Compare combined HP shaping with terminal rewards earlier in learning from the same imitation initialization, with more learner seeds and fixed evaluation checkpoints; measure learning speed. Do not extend these endpoints or open the reserved test solely on this pilot.

protocol.ablation: Same architecture and base terminal weights. Control zero potential; enemy=-0.5*enemyHPfraction; health=enemy+0.25*playerHPfraction. Each adds gamma*Phi(successor)-Phi(before); gamma=1. Real combat terminalPhi=0; genuine cutoffs bootstrap. No analytic critic wrapper.

calibration.source: One shared frozen parent-policy sample; complete episodes only for Monte Carlo targets; discarded rollout is never a PPO update.
calibration.target: Discounted base Monte Carlo return minus current weighted potential; same rows/order/count per matched seed. Fixed train-only monitor, no adaptive selection.

evaluation.primary: Mean greedy wins over two matched learner seeds; per-seed paired differences. Sampled wins and same-case loss/win HP are secondary.
evaluation.reward: Every actor evaluated with the same unshaped +1 victory +0.1 winning post-cleanup HP fraction. Shaped training returns are not cross-arm performance metrics.
evaluation.selection: Final50k only; no intermediate selection or early stopping. Parent retained as reference. No test access.
evaluation.uncertainty: Exploratory two-seed fine-tuning on previously used42-case validation; no fresh-test or from-scratch claim.

protocol.initialization: Same250k rich-combat actor and vocabulary in every arm. Identical freshly seeded value heads per learner seed, calibrated per reward using shared TRAIN data. Fresh PPO optimizer/action/shuffle RNG and disjoint continuation cursors.

limits: Two fine-tuning seeds, one inherited actor, repeatedly used42-case validation panel. No fresh-test or from-scratch claim.
Bootstrap intervals resample cases for a fixed pair of trained policies; they do not quantify across-seed model uncertainty. Sampled games share cases.
Conditional HP metrics must be compared on the same lost/won cases; raw group averages have changing composition.
Expensive low-damage flags indicate review opportunities, not proven mistakes: cards may have other useful effects.

training_audit.scope: All scalar journals checked; first victory, defeat and cutoff per chunk checked against canonical public pairs. Native recording already validated every pair during collection. No extra gameplay.
